title: Micellar extraction followed by flow injection ICP-AES for preconcentration and determination of aluminium ions
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,1546-1555
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08800C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Shahab Shariati, Yadollah Yamini, Mohammad Faraji, Abolfazl Saleh, Elahe Bozorgzadeh
A convenient and sensitive off-line cloud point extraction method (off-line CPE) was developed to preconcentrate trace amounts of aluminium ions prior to their determination by flow injection (FI) coupled to ICP-AES.
